props.gloss_en: the mishna: if [the examiner, judge or witness] was a priest, [the one who needs him] renders him impure from his teruma, etc.
answer 1: [the mishna speaks of a priest who went] to a beit haperas, which is rabbinic
Rav: a person may blow [the dust] of a beit haperas and walk
Rav Yehuda: a beit haperas that has been trodden is pure
answer 2: alternatively, [the mishna speaks of a priest made impure] with other impurities
for [priests] are not admonished about them (the other impurities)
